strategy.name: GLFT_MultiScale
strategy._comment_model_policy: GLFT is the sole Paper execution primary. A-S is the registered alternative; switching requires config change and restart.
strategy._comment_rpi: Live startup requires every configured symbol to expose RPI permission and account-specific commission truth.
strategy._comment_execution_modes: Per-venue market-making mode: post_only rests GTX/RPI quotes; market sends MARKET orders when the GLFT reservation price clears the touch by taker fee + market_execution.min_edge_bps. market is Paper-only and GLFT-only.
